claims.evidence: Witness reports stainless steel body and glass lid in visible photos.
Internal repairs or history cannot be confirmed through photos.
Functional state of burners, hotplate, and oven was not shown.

risks.risk: Gas burners may have leaks or blocked jets.
risks.proof: A video showing all three gas burners ignited simultaneously with steady blue flames.
risks.if_unproven: As requiring burner service or repair.

risks.risk: Electric hotplate may be burnt out or have wiring faults.
risks.proof: A video showing the hotplate heating up (e.g., boiling a small amount of water).

risks.risk: Oven heating element or burner may be defective.
risks.proof: A video showing the oven burner lit or the internal temperature rising.

risks.risk: Hidden structural rust or damage on the back or side panels.
risks.proof: Clear photos of the back and both side panels.

proof_requests: Video of all gas burners and the electric hotplate turned on and working.
Video of the oven being turned on and heating.
Photo of the technical specification plate/model number.
Photos of the side and back panels of the unit.
response.reason: The item type and configuration are clearly identified by the witness. It can be priced based on its worst-case functional state until proof of operation is provided.
